Introduction
## This project analyses major crime data from selected cities in West African countries collected in 1974. Using R, I created and explored vectors containing the countries, cities, and number of crimes. I then organized the data into a data frame, calculated the total number of crimes, classified cities according to their crime rates, and compared crime totals between countries. To approach this we make use of Base R function and dplyr package()

```{r}
crime_data$crime_rate <- ifelse(
  test = crime_data$n_crime >= 400,
  yes = "High", 
  no = ifelse(
  test = crime_data$n_crime >= 100 & crime_data$n_crime <= 399,
  yes = "Medium",
  no = "Low"
  )
)

crime_data

subset(crime_data, country == "Nigeria")

aggregate(crime_data$n_crime, by = list(country = country), FUN = sum)

#
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)

## Using dplyr

crime_data |>
  summarize(
    .by = country,
    total_crime = sum(n_crime),
    average_no_of_crime = mean(n_crime)
)

crime_data |>
  summarize(
    .by = country,
    total_crime = sum(n_crime),
    average_no_of_crime = mean(n_crime)
  ) |>
  top_n( n = 1, wt =total_crime)

```
